title.en: Unit 1203 S2 Ep.5 — Day 4: The Call That Won't Connect

_note: 4화 투표 결과를 확인하지 못한 채(Notion 연결 끊김) A(집으로 올라간다)를 '민수의 선택'으로 썼다. 결과가 B면 1~2번 장면을 고친다. 그림·음성 job은 아직 비어 있음.

beats.ko: 사이렌 4일째 아침, 12층 집. 엄마에게 건 전화가 연결되지 않았어요.
beats.en: Day four, morning, twelve floors up. The call to Mom would not go through.

beats.en: Minsu's choice was A, back up home, and he called ten times, but every call rang and then dropped.

beats.en: One thing you can do today is pick one person your whole family can contact, and write that name down.

beats.en: Minsu's readiness score went up to seventy-five.

tts.en: And today, Minsu's readiness score went up to seventy-five points.

beats.ko: 엄마는 다른 도시에 있어요. 민수는, A, 엄마에게 간다. B, 엄마를 이쪽으로 오시게 한다. 댓글로.
beats.en: Mom is in another city. Minsu: A, goes to her. B, asks her to come to him. Comment below.

tts.en: Mom is in another city, so does Minsu choose A, and go to her, or B, and ask her to come to him? Comment below.
